title: GSA Buy AI and OneGov Procurement Channel — Phase 65 GSA post-quantum acquisition review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the GSA post-quantum acquisition reporting pack. GSA's current Buy AI page lists enterprise AI products, promotional pricing windows, agency eligibility, purchasing paths, and implementation guidance.
key_findings: The page exposes multiple AI offerings through current federal purchasing vehicles.
It distinguishes product eligibility and time-bounded promotional pricing.
GSA recommends scoped testing, data protection, security coordination, and cost monitoring.
why_it_matters: Which records move a migration obligation through inventory, solicitation, award, interoperability test, cutover, acceptance, rollback, and legacy retirement? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. The page translates federal AI acquisition policy into an operating purchasing surface, moving the next evidence question to actual agency orders, authorization, use, cost, and outcomes.
ftfn_relevance: Adds a civilian procurement implementation path distinct from the defense prototype agreement.
Creates follow-up gates for adoption and measured mission value.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
Availability does not prove any agency acquired or used a listed product.
Promotional pricing does not capture implementation, usage, security, training, renewal, or switching costs.
